waypoints.name: SR-20 Hairpin / Pond Pullout (east of Washington Pass)
waypoints.note: Pullout on the north shoulder of SR-20 at the hairpin curve just east of Washington Pass, below Liberty Bell; walk back toward the pass to the small pond on the south side of the highway.
waypoints.directions: Drive SR-20 (North Cascades Highway) to Washington Pass and continue east down from the pass to the big hairpin turn below Liberty Bell's East Face, at about 5,200 ft; coming from Winthrop it is the hairpin just before the final climb to the pass. Park on the north shoulder at the curve, then walk back up the road toward the pass to a small pond on the south side, where the climbers' path starts at its east end. SR-20 is closed over the pass in winter.

waypoints.name: Committing mid-wall position
waypoints.note: 5.11 to 5.12a free crux pitches with sparse retreat once established on the wall; carry a topo and be ready to aid past the hard sections.

waypoints.name: Liberty Bell summit
waypoints.note: Grade V outing tops out on the true summit; descend via the standard Beckey Route rappels/downclimb to the notch, not back down the route.
